title: HVAC, Dehumidification, Airflow, CO2 & Dew-Point Concepts
description: Specialist module covering environmental loads, dew point, dehumidification, airflow, CO2 safety and evidence-based equipment handoff.
learningOutcomes: Differentiate sensible heat load from latent moisture load and use trend data to identify when temperature control and moisture removal are behaving differently.
Interpret dew point, cooling, dehumidification and lights-off transitions to identify condensation and high-humidity risk without reducing the problem to RH alone.
Evaluate airflow distribution using spatial crop-zone evidence rather than fan speed or room averages alone.
Explain CO2 monitoring and compressed-gas safety boundaries, including oxygen-displacement/asphyxiation risk and emergency escalation, without treating worker exposure limits as enrichment targets.
Produce a reconstructable environmental-system handoff that links symptoms, sensor trends, equipment state, likely failure class, evidence limits and qualified escalation.
